verdict.rationale: Intel Gaudi 3 is a hardware AI accelerator (a PCIe or OAM card deployed in servers), not a hosted data service. Choosing a storage region or data residency is not an axis this kind of product offers. The single mention of trying Gaudi 'in the cloud' says nothing about Gaudi itself offering region or residency selection, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
